1 Vision System Data Science Engineer (all genders) LOCATION: Villach, AT, 9500
REQ ID: 204410

What you'll do
 * Design, develop, and deploy computer vision algorithms for detection, classification, segmentation, anomaly detection, and predictive analytics.
 * Build scalable machine learning and deep learning models using image, video, and multimodal sensor data.
 * Lead the complete data science lifecycle, including data collection, labeling, feature engineering, model training, validation, deployment, and monitoring.
 * Develop robust image-processing pipelines utilizing modern computer vision frameworks and cloud technologies.
 * Collaborate with process engineers, software developers, hardware engineers, and product teams to deliver integrated vision solutions.
 * Conduct root-cause analysis and use advanced analytics to improve yield, process stability, and equipment performance.
 * Drive innovation by evaluating emerging AI, machine learning, and computer vision technologies.
 * Mentor junior engineers and provide technical guidance on best practices in data science and machine learning.
 * Translate analytical insights into standardized current best-known methods (cBKM) to enable scalable and sustainable business impact.
 * Design, develop, and maintain production-grade Python applications, libraries, and data science solutions following established software engineering best practices.
 * Process, structure, and analyze large-scale datasets while optimizing data pipelines, databases, and data architectures to support advanced analytics.

Who we're looking for
 * Bachelor's or Master's degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Industrial Engineering, Applied Mathematics, or a related field. 
 * Typically requires a minimum of 5 years of related experience with a Bachelor's degree; or 3 years and a Master's degree; or equivalent work experience.
 * Proven experience developing, deploying, and managing predictive maintenance or machine learning models in production environments.
 * Demonstrated ability to perform complex, non-routine engineering and data analyses that influence product and business decisions.
 * Strong expertise in Docker and containerized application deployment.
 * Project management skills, including the ability to translate strategic objectives into structured work packages and executable plans.
 * Experience with large-scale data processing, data modeling, data warehousing, and data engineering concepts.
 * Strong presentation and data visualization skills.
 * Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English.

Preferred Qualifications

 * Knowledge of optical systems, cameras, sensors, and imaging hardware.
 * Expert-level proficiency in Python, statistical modeling, machine learning, and data visualization.
 * Working knowledge of PowerShell, R, SQL, and database technologies.
 * Experience developing and implementing artificial intelligence solutions and advanced analytics applications.
 * Familiarity with cloud-based analytics platforms, MLOps practices, and software development lifecycle management.
 * Experience leading data science projects in semiconductor environments.

What you'll do
 * Lead, coach and develop a team of mechanical engineers working on semiconductor wafer-processing equipment through regular 1:1s, feedback and development discussions.
 * Oversee team performance, workforce and resource planning, hiring, onboarding and talent development, and build a strong succession pipeline for key roles.
 * Promote a team culture built on ownership, collaboration, continuous improvement and high engineering standards.
 * Plan team capacity across development and program work, sustaining engineering, problem reports, obsolescence and customer escalations.
 * Contribute to the technical roadmap, and present progress, risks and recommendations to senior management.
 * Act as reviewer and decision maker in design reviews. Give technical guidance on design, materials, testing and validation in line with SEMI, company and GD&T standards.
 * Own the team's incoming work, including technical problem reports, supplier requests, customer-specific requests and engineering change management (Change Review Board, ECNs).
 * Handle engineering escalations from customers, production and suppliers. Contain issues quickly, align stakeholders on actions and communicate status until resolution.
 * Drive obsolescence management, from validating replacement parts through qualification and last-time-buy input.
 * Represent Engineering in cross-functional problem solving and continuous improvement activities (8D, root cause analysis, corrective actions), ensuring lessons learned drive sustainable improvements. Be the primary engineering interface for Supply Chain, Production, and suppliers.
 * Act as key user for engineering tools (Teamcenter PLM, Compliance Quest, SAP Fiori), including training and testing.

Who we're looking for
 * Bachelor's degree or higher in Mechanical Engineering or a related field.
 * 6+ years of relevant engineering experience, including experience in concept development and concept testing.
 * 3+ years of proven leadership experience as a people manager, team lead or technical lead.
 * Strong mechanical design background (metals, ceramics, quartz, plastics, coatings) and 3D CAD experience (Siemens NX, Creo, SolidWorks or similar).
 * Solid knowledge of structured development and change processes (PLM, design reviews, FMEA, test specifications).
 * Strong prioritization and communication skills. Fluent in English; German is an advantage. 

Preferred Qualifications

 * Experience in semiconductor equipment development or another high-tech industry.
 * Experience with Teamcenter PLM, Compliance Quest or similar systems.
 * Experience in coaching and talent development, project management and resource planning.
 * Experience working with teams across several sites.
